scenario: A path, status, or branch changes between capture and validation.
expectedOutcome: Reject stale evidence and recapture before classification or source reconciliation.
startingState: A read-only worktree snapshot is captured under a revision-pinned capsule.
injectedEvent: A concurrent writer adds or changes one pending path after capture.
invariants: No source or Git mutation is allowed.
Every pending path must retain its exact status.
A stale snapshot cannot promote its parent.
firstPass: A fresh status fingerprint differs, so validation fails closed.
reviewPass: Applying the same rule still requires recapture and never widens scope.
reconciledResult: Compare immediately before promotion; pass only when branch identity and the full status set match.
assumptions: Git porcelain-v2 reports every tracked and untracked path requested by the capsule.
uncertainty: Low; later external writes require the next leaf to recheck.
repairRoute: Repeat this atomic snapshot leaf at the newest matrix revision.
